recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量高，間質可見散在核偏位的漿細胞、數個巨核細胞與少量含鐵血黃素；在此倍率漿細胞增加不算顯眼，需搭配 CD138 染色才能準確評估漿細胞增多。
features: Scattered interstitial plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm, not forming sheets
Numerous megakaryocytes, some large with hyperlobated nuclei
Focal golden-brown hemosiderin pigment in macrophages
No discrete infiltrate or fibrosis evident at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and numerous megakaryocytes. Scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm are present interstitially, but they do not form clusters or sheets and are difficult to quantify at this magnification. Focal hemosiderin-laden macrophages are noted. The findings are compatible with a reactive marrow with interstitial plasmacytosis in the setting of HIV infection; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains are needed to quantify plasma cells and confirm polytypism.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows clustered or sheet-like plasma cells with light-chain restriction rather than scattered polytypic interstitial plasma cells.
MPNs show clustered, atypical megakaryocytes with driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL), whereas megakaryocytes here are dispersed within a reactive background.
HIV myelopathy may show dysplasia but lacks recurrent MDS cytogenetic abnormalities and blasts are not increased.
